target: Working Clay Machine: ClayCode language + compiler + VM + Clay environment + Linux interoperability + minimal ClayOS

CM-01-LANGUAGE-SPEC-PARSER-IR.goal: Canonical ClayCode syntax, parser, AST/IR and corpus authority with unknown constructs failing closed.
CM-01-LANGUAGE-SPEC-PARSER-IR.call_ownership_evidence: PR #598 merged a syntax-only partition of bare unqualified versus dotted callee targets; no import/member/host semantics selected.

CM-02-TYPE-EFFECT-SYSTEM.goal: Nominal/structural type and effect semantics independent of Python recursion/host defaults, with bounded complexity and explicit semantic authority.
CM-02-TYPE-EFFECT-SYSTEM.blocker: The non-copying mutable-path candidate reproduced on self-hosted Linux/X64, but production runtime/claycode_typecheck_v1/typecheck.py remains unmodified. Production integration plus exact-head semantic/complexity regression is required before treating TypeRef totality as complexity-robust.
CM-02-TYPE-EFFECT-SYSTEM.candidate: PR #605 is closed unmerged and intentionally isolated from production. Its self-hosted candidate gate passed 5/5 semantic/totality controls at alias-wrapped depth 4096 on run 31910166336.
CM-02-TYPE-EFFECT-SYSTEM.local_discriminator: At alias-wrapped depth 2048, current copy-per-branch prototype measured 0.023614s versus 0.001776s for the mutable-path candidate (~13.3x); direct-cycle, structural-cycle and sibling-branch controls passed. Sandbox timing is not release evidence.

CM-03-EVALUATOR-INTERPRETER.goal: Fail-closed executable ClayCode evaluator for admitted language semantics; no host behavior by default.

CM-04-COMPILER-LOWERING-BYTECODE.goal: Define lowering and executable bytecode/IR with deterministic verifier and compiler receipts.
CM-04-COMPILER-LOWERING-BYTECODE.candidate: PR #600 provides deterministic serialized CLAYVM bytecode for a detached claycode.typed-ir.v0 Int/Bool bootstrap subset and now has exact-head self-hosted execution evidence.
CM-04-COMPILER-LOWERING-BYTECODE.blocker: Canonical ClayCodeBaseTypedIR/v1 currently carries typed declarations/signatures but function bodies remain body_tokens; it does not yet provide the canonical typed executable expression graph needed to prove semantics-preserving lowering into the single ClayVM. Direct token reparsing or detached bootstrap dictionaries must not masquerade as canonical compiler output.

CM-05-VIRTUAL-CLAY-MACHINE.goal: Implement Clay VM instruction semantics, execution loop, call/stack/object model, traps, limits and deterministic tests.
CM-05-VIRTUAL-CLAY-MACHINE.candidate: PR #600 provides the first Python-hosted serialized ClayVM bootstrap slice. Head dda5992709bcdd3800fa90c2526ed5aebf43a6e2 replaces Python-recursive OP_CALL with VM-owned activation frames and an explicit max_frames resource limit.
CM-05-VIRTUAL-CLAY-MACHINE.blocker: The prior Python-recursive call-stack blocker is closed for the tested bootstrap head. VM promotion remains coupled to CM-04's canonical executable TypedIR/lowering boundary and to broader verifier/object/runtime semantics; component PASS is not whole-machine PASS.
CM-05-VIRTUAL-CLAY-MACHINE.review: PR #600 review 4944772646 recorded the original call-stack obligation.

CM-06-MEMORY-CONCURRENCY-RUNTIME.goal: Define VM memory/object lifetime, concurrency/scheduling and failure semantics.

CM-07-CLAY-ENVIRONMENT-STDLIB-SDK.goal: A self-contained Clay environment directory/runtime with standard library, modules, packaging and developer SDK.

CM-08-LINUX-INTEROP.goal: Typed capability-bound Linux filesystem/process/network/device/FFI interop with explicit effects, receipts and fail-closed boundaries.
CM-08-LINUX-INTEROP.candidate: PR #600 contains a capability-only bootstrap host boundary, but this is not yet deep typed Linux interop acceptance.

CM-09-MINIMAL-CLAYOS.goal: Minimal ClayOS services/shell/runtime personality hosted by the Clay VM/environment, sufficient to demonstrate boot, program execution, state and Linux interaction.
CM-09-MINIMAL-CLAYOS.candidate: PR #600 contains a minimal RUNNING/EXITED/TRAPPED process facade; draft bootstrap only, not ClayOS completion.

CM-10-TOOLING-OBSERVABILITY-RECOVERY.goal: Compiler/VM diagnostics, fuzzing, replay, crash/recovery, provenance, performance and reproducibility gates.

CM-11-SELF-HOSTING-BOOTSTRAP.goal: Progressively move selected compiler/runtime components into ClayCode and prove bootstrap equivalence without circular trust.

frontier.next_discriminator: Wire the proven non-copying TypeRef active-alias path into production typecheck.py with exact-head regression; for the VM lane, define a canonical typed executable expression IR after type/effect checking and prove deterministic source/IR -> single-CLAYVM lowering without raw-token semantic reinvention.

coordination_negative_result: Parallel GO workers can currently collide on the exactly-one unusual-experiment cardinality; shared CAS/lease serialization remains required.
laws: ClayVerse/Clay Machine is the only active program.
GRF expands hypotheses but does not mint truth.
Legacy Frank/self.root/UCM2 paths are evidence only.
No hidden host semantics, generic semantics, effect authority, or completion claims from names or model consensus.
No final paid training without explicit owner authorization.
